checks.claim: Five vendors selected for five named bases on 2026-08-26, up to $2.2bn across FY2027-FY2031 under milestone-based Other Transactions agreements the Army says it is negotiating; four of the nine candidate sites are still unassigned
checks.evidence: Breaking Defense, dated 2026-08-26, names five vendors and bases: Antares at Fort Bragg, BWXT at Fort Campbell, General Atomics at Fort Hood, Radiant at Fort Benning and Westinghouse at Fort Drum. It describes the $2.2 billion as a share of a pot spent between fiscal 2027 and 2031. It names Fort Wainwright, Holston, Joint Base Lewis-McChord and Redstone as the other sites from the November 2025 list of nine, which leaves four candidate sites without a named vendor. The Other Transaction and negotiation wording was not in the fetched text, so this verdict covers the vendor, base, date and dollar-span parts of the claim.
